findings.scope: Typed compiled/partial key-resolution interface; downstream strict metric guards are separate
findings.reason: Float version0.0 is normalized despite the established strict version contract, and overlapping writable/readonly lookup indices with distinct loaded keys are accepted.
findings.requested_fix: Use the shared strict version contract and reject cross-group table-index collisions without trusting caller flags.

findings.scope: Opaque partial address form versus compiled index form
findings.reason: An opaque account string and an explicit opaque programId can introduce keys absent from the resolved primary account table, while index-form equivalents are bounded by that table. Both controls return successful transfer normalizations without issues.
findings.requested_fix: Validate opaque program/account membership in the resolved key table; keep fully parsed historical support unchanged.

findings.scope: Program provenance projection and malformed loaded-address input
findings.reason: _program_facts renormalizes the entire transaction N+1 times; counts8/32/128 require9/33/129 complete passes and timings grow approximately quadratically. A loaded-array/count mismatch performs2054 public-key decodes before rejecting2048 entries.
findings.requested_fix: Normalize once per source projection and batch original-path mapping; reject impossible loaded lengths/counts before decoding individual keys.
